The results orchestrator returns that outcome as built (no relaxation retry, no relaxed_* / no_result notice, no ordinary suggestions, tlj_none kept), and continuation calls (换一批 / 再便宜点 / 换平台) keep benefits, brand, category_hint and exclude_keywords; a taolijin chain never yields a product_list. The six defaults where 08 is silent were confirmed by the orchestrator (2026-11-10 16:32).
